RULES_FOR_EVERYTHING_DOWNSTREAM: This file is the ONLY thing anything downstream may cite. If a fact is not here, it does not exist for this study.
Every claim below was re-fetched and verified verbatim by the fact-checker on 2026-08-09, or by the showrunner directly where marked showrunner_verified.
The source pages render the office hours with an EN DASH. This project bans en dashes in every artifact. Always re-set it as '7:00 AM to 3:00 PM'.

A DRIFT PATTERN was found and named in this run's fact-check, running one direction, toward making this company look more prominent and further behind than the pages support. Four separate embellishments all leaned that way. The verified spine below is stronger than any of them and needs none of them. Watch for it returning.

identity.claim: White Pass & Yukon Route describes itself as an historic, scenic railway headquartered in Skagway, Alaska, with depot offices also located in Carcross, YT and Whitehorse, YT.
identity.quote: The White Pass & Yukon Route is an historic, scenic railway headquartered in Skagway, Alaska, with Depot offices also located in Carcross, YT, and Whitehorse, YT.

identity.claim: The railway was completed in 1900 and has operated exclusively as a historical tourist attraction since 1988.
identity.quote: The railway was completed in 1900 and has operated exclusively as a historical tourist attraction since 1988.

identity.claim: The railroad employs 180 people, most of them based in Skagway.
identity.quote: The White Pass & Yukon Route Railroad employs 180 people, most of which are based in Skagway.

identity.claim: KTOO describes the company as one of Skagway's largest employers, and its headline calls it Skagway's largest tourist attraction.
identity.CORRECTION_NOTE: The phrase 'largest private employer' was REJECTED by the fact-checker and appears nowhere in the source. Only the two wordings above may be used.

identity.claim: Ownership, in the company's own words. Klondike Holdings, LLC purchased White Pass & Yukon Route on August 1, 2018.
identity.quote: Klondike Holdings, LLC is an ownership group formed of majority partner Survey Point Holdings and its affiliates and long time partners based in Seattle along with minority partner Carnival PLC.

identity.claim: Carnival's own release announcing the transaction quotes Stein Kruse, Group CEO of Carnival Corporation & plc's Holland America Group and Carnival UK, and names TWC Enterprises Limited as the seller. No sale price is disclosed on the page.
identity.quote: We are delighted that the Skagway port will continue to be locally owned and independently operated by an Alaskan company.

identity.claim: Almost 2,000 train starts run through the summer season.
identity.quote: With almost 2,000 train starts throughout the summer season, we are the busiest we have ever been.

how_they_sell.claim: The reservation office is published as Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM Alaska Time. This appears on two independent product pages, so it is standing policy rather than a one-page typo.
how_they_sell.quote: Monday-Friday 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM Alaska Time
how_they_sell.EN_DASH_WARNING: The source renders an en dash between the times. Never reproduce it.

how_they_sell.claim: Cancelling or altering a booking requires a phone call to the reservation office. There is no online path.
how_they_sell.quote: Please call 1-800-343-7373 to speak with the reservation office to cancel or alter a reservation.
how_they_sell.SCOPE_NOTE: The cancellation page itself does NOT state office hours. The weekday-only constraint must be carried from the product pages (c10), never attributed to this page.

how_they_sell.claim: The refund clock is 24 hours before departure, with a stated per-person penalty.
how_they_sell.quote: A cancellation may be made up to 24 hours prior to departure to receive a refund (minus penalty).
how_they_sell.quote_2: If a cancellation is made within 24 hours of departure time, guest forfeits all rights to a refund.

how_they_sell.claim: The Summit excursion is sold through the Princess, Holland America Line, Carnival and Norwegian shore excursion departments with dockside boarding, alongside a direct phone channel at 1-800-343-7373.
The direct fare and the cruise-line fare for the same ride differ. The Points Guy, having checked both, reports the direct online fare and Norwegian's listed price.
how_they_sell.quote: Tickets purchased online at least 24 hours in advance are $155 per adult and $77.50 per child for the 2 1/2- to 3-hour trip.
how_they_sell.quote_2: Norwegian's current prices listed online are $229 for adults and $149 for kids, a difference of nearly $80 for adults.
how_they_sell.quote_3: The popular train rides usually sell out in advance, especially during peak cruise season.
how_they_sell.quote_4: online on the White Pass and Yukon Route Railway website, over the phone at 800-343-7373 or through your cruise line's app, website or shore excursion desk
how_they_sell.TIER: Third-party travel journalism that checked both channels. Not the company's own published channel mix, and no channel split is published anywhere. Treat the gap as a per-ticket price difference on one product, never as a revenue split.

how_they_sell.claim: Published 2026 fares. Summit Excursion $155 adult and $77.50 child, children 0 to 2 complimentary. Bennett Scenic Journey $289 adult and $144.50 child. Steam Summit Loop $249 adult and $180 child. Fraser one way $108 adult and $54 child. Carcross one way $210 adult and $105 child. Whitehorse to Skagway One Day Combo $175 adult and $87.50 child. Skagway to Denver $60 adult and $30 child. Skagway to Laughton $106 adult and $53 child. Chilkoot Hiker Service $60 and up.
how_they_sell.CORRECTION_NOTE: An earlier grouping of all three hiker services at $60 was REJECTED. Denver, Laughton and Chilkoot carry different prices and are listed separately above.

how_they_sell.claim: The 2026 Summit season runs April 30 to October 7, 2026, with stated service exceptions.
how_they_sell.exceptions: No service available May 2-4; September 26-27; October 1, 3-5.

how_they_sell.claim: The Bennett Scenic Journey 2026 season runs May 26 to September 12, 2026.
The company's contact page offers a phone number, an email address, a fax and a contact form, with no live chat widget present.
how_they_sell.SCOPE_NOTE: This page carries NO office hours. Cite it only for the channels and the absence of chat. An earlier claim citing it for the hours was REJECTED as mis-pointed.

how_they_sell.claim: On 2026-08-09 the online ticketing system returned an unavailable message directing customers to the phone line and an email inbox. The same page simultaneously rendered an order-processing thank you and a warning not to close the browser window.
how_they_sell.quote: White Pass & Yukon Route Ticketing System is currently unavailable. Please contact the Reservations Office at 1-800-343-7373 or via email at info@wpyr.com.
how_they_sell.quote_2: Do NOT close this window until you see 'Payment Success!'
how_they_sell.observations: Three independent same-day observations, by the company-analyst, by the showrunner, and by the fact-checker.
how_they_sell.MANDATORY_CAVEAT: An outage is a point-in-time observation and could be transient. This caveat MUST ship in the same breath as the claim, everywhere the claim appears. Never present it as a standing condition.

how_they_sell.claim: Five cruise ships were listed arriving in Skagway on Sunday August 9, 2026.
how_they_sell.detail: Carnival Miracle 07:00, Island Princess 07:00, Silver Moon 07:00, Disney Magic 07:15, Viking Orion 23:59.
how_they_sell.TIER: Third-party schedule aggregator, medium confidence. Label it as a published schedule, not as the company's own figure.

the_work_inside.claim: The Reservation Agent role combines entering bookings into the ticketing system, answering the same questions across three channels, and being pulled onto the platform for train loading and crossing-guard duty.
the_work_inside.quote_2: Answering questions via phone, email, and in person regarding White Pass products
the_work_inside.quote_3: Assisting the Passenger Department with train loading, passenger transfers and crossing-guard duties

the_work_inside.claim: The company states it is actively seeking candidates fluent in other languages, naming Spanish and Japanese in particular.
the_work_inside.quote: We are actively seeking candidates who can speak other languages fluently, in particular Spanish and Japanese, however any foreign language skills are a plus.

the_work_inside.claim: On 2026-08-09 Reservation Agent was listed among open 2026 positions in Carcross, Yukon and in Whitehorse, Yukon, and was not listed for Skagway.
the_work_inside.CORRECTION_NOTE: An earlier wording claimed the Skagway role was 'marked closed'. REJECTED. Absence from a list is not an affirmative closed marking. Say 'not listed', never 'marked closed'.

the_work_inside.claim: About 40 workers, including tour guides, announcers and workers who greet visitors as they leave their cruise ships, voted to join SMART-TD's local chapter on April 8.
the_work_inside.company_quote: Our employees have the right to organize and we look forward to working with our onboard staff in this new capacity.
the_work_inside.UNVERIFIED_SUBCLAIMS: The '35 existing SMART-TD members', 'roughly doubling the local's membership', the Teamsters involvement and a '2027 review' were NOT verified and may not be used.

the_work_inside.claim: A navigation link labelled FAQ points to the company's travel blog, and that page carries no frequently-asked-questions content.
the_work_inside.HANDLING: EVIDENCE ONLY, and low-value evidence at that. OUTREACH_CRAFT bans gotcha openings and this is one. It may never be a headline, an opening sentence, or a framed finding.

the_work_inside.claim: Recruiting copy states the company expects over 500,000 guests in the summer, and lists a May 1 to September 30, 2026 recruiting season.
the_work_inside.quote: We are looking for top candidates to help us tell our 125 year old history to over 500,000 guests this summer!
the_work_inside.MANDATORY_CAVEAT: This is RECRUITING COPY, not an audited passenger count. The most recent figure the company publishes itself is over 385,000 passengers in 2012, which is fourteen years old. Any use of 500,000 must carry the recruiting-copy label in the same sentence.

the_work_inside.claim: Six 30-class engines are currently in Skagway, with the seventh and eighth to be delivered in 2026.
the_work_inside.quote: With six engines currently in Skagway, we will receive delivery of the seventh and eighth in 2026.
the_work_inside.CORRECTION_NOTE: 'In service' was REJECTED. The page says currently in Skagway.

the_field_around_them.claim: Alaska Railroad runs a customer-facing chatbot branded Ask Denali.
the_field_around_them.SCOPE_NOTE: Verified on ONE page. The earlier claims of a three-page site-level deployment and a 2026-to-2027 filterable availability calendar were both REJECTED and may not be used.

the_field_around_them.claim: Shoretime, the cloud platform built specifically to run cruise shore-excursion operations end to end and partnered with Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings since February 20, 2024, makes no artificial-intelligence claim anywhere on its site. Its features are sold as automation and integration.
quotes: Unify the bid portal with sales, operations and settlement
Integrate email and system messages into a singular inbox
streamline all interdependent operations and service experiences, through the automation of tasks
the_field_around_them.WHY_IT_MATTERS: The people closest to this exact workflow, who would have every commercial incentive to say AI, are not saying it. The fact-checker called this the strongest and most honest finding in the package.

the_field_around_them.claim: Only 12 percent of tour, activity and attraction operators actively use AI in their operations, with most still experimenting or not using it at all. From Arival's Global Operator Landscape, third edition, a survey of more than 7,000 operators worldwide, published October 22, 2024.
the_field_around_them.quote: While only 12% of operators actively use AI in their operations, with most still experimenting or not using it at all.
the_field_around_them.CORRECTION_NOTE: The page says AI, NOT generative AI. Drop the word generative. A separate claim that 'more than half of small operators are doing nothing with AI at all' was REJECTED, it is not on the page and it manufactured both precision and pessimism.

the_field_around_them.claim: Amtrak's ARROW revenue management system achieved an average additional revenue of 3 to 5 percent. In the same survey, SNCF's RailRev and Deutsche Bahn's PET are named as real deployments with no quantified gain published.
the_field_around_them.quote: Amtrak developed the ARROW revenue management system and achieved an average additional revenue of 3-5%
the_field_around_them.SCOPE_NOTE: Scope the superlative to this paper. 'The only quantified figure in this survey' is defensible. 'The only one in the peer-reviewed literature' is a universal claim one paper cannot carry.

the_field_around_them.claim: In Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149, decided February 19, 2024, the British Columbia Civil Resolution Tribunal held Air Canada liable for a negligent misrepresentation made by the chatbot on its own website, rejecting the argument that the chatbot was a separate entity.
the_field_around_them.quote: It should be obvious to Air Canada that it is responsible for all the information on its website.
the_field_around_them.quote_2: Air Canada did not take reasonable care to ensure its chatbot was accurate.

the_field_around_them.claim: An experimental study of 467 German adults, published February 21, 2025 in Tourism and Hospitality, used a 2 by 3 between-subjects design comparing an AI chatbot against a human agent across positive, neutral and negative booking situations. It found booking intention significantly lower for chatbots than for humans, and significantly lower in negative situations.
the_field_around_them.quote: Chatbots are recognized during the booking process and less accepted to support bookings than their human counterparts.
the_field_around_them.CRITICAL_CORRECTION: The INTERACTION effect was STATISTICALLY INSIGNIFICANT. The research package claimed human agents 'significantly outperformed chatbots ... with the steepest decline for chatbots in the negative scenario', which overstates it. The paper reports the interaction ANOVA as insignificant, with only a DESCRIPTIVE pattern suggesting sharper chatbot declines in negative scenarios. Any use must say the two main effects were significant and the interaction was not. Do NOT claim the study proves chatbots specifically lose the sale when the news is bad.

the_field_around_them.claim: Fortune reported on June 2, 2026 that Chipotle's time from application to first day on the job dropped from 12 days to four after deploying a conversational hiring assistant, and that about 30 percent of scheduling work now happens after hours.
the_field_around_them.quote: The time from application to first day on the job has dropped from 12 days to four.
the_field_around_them.quote_2: About 30% of that scheduling work now happens after hours, time that would have previously required a general manager to be on the clock.
the_field_around_them.ATTRIBUTION_CORRECTION: REPORTED BY FORTUNE in its own voice, NOT spoken by an executive. An earlier version attributed both figures to COO Jason Kidd as direct speech. REJECTED.
the_field_around_them.kidd_quote_verified_separately: At the end of the day, that applicant ends up working for a human. So how far can we push it?
the_field_around_them.SIZE_CAVEAT: Chipotle is enormous. The direction transfers, the magnitude does not.

the_field_around_them.claim: Black Cat Cruises, a two-location New Zealand marine wildlife cruise operator running up to four daily departures from Akaroa, reports its website chatbot handles about 500 conversations a month, answers around 60 percent of customer questions, and saves staff 10 hours a month. It generates about 15 monthly clickthroughs to the booking system, which the vendor values at a modelled $3,750 a month. Only 10 percent of site visitors leave an email address.
the_field_around_them.ceo_quote: Our new chat bot, 'Kiri', handles 500+ conversations per month, saving frontline staff hours of time each week.
the_field_around_them.TIER: VENDOR CASE STUDY WITH A NAMED CUSTOMER. Not independent. Label it as vendor-published every time it is used.
the_field_around_them.WHICH_NUMBER_TO_TRUST: The 10 hours a month is the trustworthy figure. The $3,750 is modelled, not banked, and must never be quoted as revenue.

the_field_around_them.claim: Guest-inquiry chat for tourism operators is a priced, off-the-shelf market. Yonder publishes monthly list pricing of $95 for 80 chats, $195 for 200 chats and $295 for 500 chats, with unlimited on application. There is no fixed-term contract, and configuration is done by the vendor's in-house conversation design team over one to four weeks.
the_field_around_them.quote: we don't lock you into fixed-term contracts
the_field_around_them.quote_2: Yonder has an in-house conversation design team that will work with you to configure, train, and test your new AI Chatbot. The process takes between 1-4 weeks, depending on the overall size and complexity of the build.
the_field_around_them.TIER: vendor list pricing, which is a fact about what things cost, not a claim about what they achieve

the_field_around_them.claim: FareHarbor's AI guest-communication product, FareHarbor Agent, is described by FareHarbor as currently rolling out to a select group of operators, with no named customer, no pricing and no measured outcome published.
the_field_around_them.HANDLING: The fact-checker did not re-verify this page. Use only if re-checked, and never as evidence of anything working.

competitors_in_port.claim: Several Skagway operators sell packages built around White Pass's own train and price them above the railway's direct fare. Chilkoot Charters lists White Pass Summit Rail and Bus at $200 adult, White Pass Summit Rail and Suspension Bridge at $238 adult, and Yukon Rail and Bus at $270 adult, against the railway's own $155 direct Summit fare. Beyond Skagway Tours runs a rail combo named Ride the Rail, and Sockeye Cycle runs a White Pass Train and Bike Tour.
competitors_in_port.HANDLING: The fact-checker did not re-verify these pages this pass. Any specific price quoted from them must be re-checked before it ships. The general pattern, that other operators resell the train inside their own packages, is corroborated by the railway's own product being listed on a cruise line's shore excursion page (c13).

competitors_in_port.claim: Skagway competitors run self-service booking engines. Frontier Excursions uses RezdyPay, TEMSCO Helicopters and Beyond Skagway use FareHarbor, and Klondike Tours uses Peek.
The competitor set was cross-checked against the Skagway Chamber of Commerce tour operator directory, which lists 18 operators including White Pass itself.
No AI feature was found on any of the Skagway operator sites fetched.
competitors_in_port.HONEST_LIMITATION: Chat widgets are usually JavaScript-injected and a markdown fetch will not always see them, so every 'none found' is a FLOOR, not a proof of absence. This limitation must ship with the claim wherever it is used.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: The phrase appears nowhere in the KTOO source. The article says 'one of Skagway's largest employers'. Upgrading 'one of the largest' to 'the largest' and narrowing 'employers' to 'private employer' are both unsupported.
No price appears on either cited page. Carnival's release explicitly discloses none.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.claim: More than half of small operators are doing nothing with AI at all
rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: Not on the page. Arival says 'most still experimenting or not using it at all', which lumps experimenters with non-users and gives no small-operator breakout.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.claim: Tripadvisor and Viator are inside ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Alexa+, per an April 23 2026 newsroom post, quoted as 'get trusted experience and hotel recommendations directly inside a Claude conversation'
rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: No such post and no such string exists at the cited URL, which is a rolling index rather than a permalink. A quoted sentence that is not on the page it cites is the highest-severity defect available here, because the prospect can open the link. The entire channel-risk framing that leaned on it is dropped.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.claim: All three hiker services at $60 adult
rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: Denver is $60, Laughton is $106, Chilkoot is '$60 and up'. The grouping understated Laughton by 77 percent.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.claim: COO Jason Kidd said application-to-first-day fell from 12 days to 4
rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: Fortune reports both figures in its own voice. Neither is presented as Kidd's speech.
That page carries no hours. Citation defect, the hours are real but live on the product pages.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.claim: The Skagway Reservation Agent is marked closed
rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: Absence from a list is not an affirmative closed marking.

rejected_and_may_never_be_used.claim: Ask Denali verified on three pages, site-level deployment, calendar filterable 2026 to 2027
rejected_and_may_never_be_used.why: Verified on one page. The amplifiers are unconfirmed.
The company's own two pages disagree, the product page says 2.5 to 2.75 hours and the index says 2.75 to 3 hours. Print the range with its page or omit.

contact.name: Bob Berto
contact.verification: Independently fetched and confirmed by both the people-finder and the fact-checker on 2026-08-09. Present in plain text in the administration directory with the title President, not obfuscated, not behind a form. Eight further named staff on the same page carry wpyr.com addresses, which makes the surveypt.com outlier a deliberate published address rather than a pattern guess. Matches character for character across both reads.

alternates.person: Allyson Nannini, Manager of Reservations & Sales
Vickey Moy, Executive Director of Passenger Operations

contact.decision_maker_reasoning: Berto sits at the top of the only published org listing the company has and is also named as a director of Survey Point Holdings, the majority partner. The operating decision and the ownership vote sit in the same person, so a technology decision does not have to travel to an absentee owner.

no_it_lead: No CIO, IT director, IT manager or technology lead appears anywhere on the published directory, and no COO, CEO, GM or Director of Operations title is published either. This is an UNVERIFIED INFERENCE about capability and must NEVER be stated as a fact about the company. It may only be used, if at all, as a statement about what their own published directory does and does not list.
hard_limits_on_this_study: ZERO verbatim customer reviews were obtainable. TripAdvisor, Yelp, Cruise Critic and KHNS all returned HTTP 403 to every attempt. Nothing may be paraphrased from a search snippet. The study may not characterise what customers say.
NO channel split is published. The share of revenue arriving through cruise shore-excursion desks versus direct is UNKNOWN. c14 is a per-ticket price difference on one product, nothing more.
NO current passenger count is published. The company's own newest figure is 385,000 from 2012. The 500,000 is recruiting copy.
NO trains-per-day figure is published. Only 'almost 2,000 train starts' across a season.
NO year-round versus seasonal headcount split is published.
The Carnival stake percentage is not published anywhere fetched.

DO NOT call this an Alaska-owned company. The company's own page calls the majority partner's affiliates Seattle-based, and Carnival's release calls it an Alaskan company. Unresolved. Use only 'Skagway' and 'one of Skagway's largest employers'.

A customer booking record found reachable without authentication is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from this file, the study, the demo, the email and the published package. It is a third party's personal data, publishing it to a public URL would amplify the exposure, and responsible disclosure is a human decision. It is surfaced to Talon privately.
